check: The HD 181327 debris ring rendered in the application, face-on and tilted
method: Headless Chromium, 1440 x 900 px at device scale 1, the local dev server, /hd-181327/?dataset=debris-ring, 4 s after load, then ten wheel steps out to about 350 au (face-on) and one more step and a 150 px upward drag (tilted). No console errors on either page.

images.rendered-face-on.webp: Altitude 349 au, the default viewing direction from Earth
images.rendered-tilted.webp: Altitude 562 au after the drag; baked at 48 slices an axis

stripeAmplitude.method: rms of a detrended pixel column through the ring at x = 1000 px, tilted view
stripeAmplitude.note: the two tilted captures were taken at 349 and 562 au, so the comparison is indicative, not like for like
